d3m1-l1.lead: A demand is not a request for money; it is a **presentation of a debt owed**, built on the legal and procedural foundation.

concepts.text: Three pillars every demand stands on: SOL, Liability Framework, Coverage Analysis. Know **the why behind the paperwork**.
more: SOL: docketed, 02/06/2028 on John Doe's file
Liability: Smith's stop-sign citation, Ruth Calloway and the doorbell video
Coverage: Keystone's Dec Page (03/20/2026), BI limit $10,000
Confirm all three before the demand is drafted

concepts.text: A within-limits demand with a stated window: it **forces a decision on the record**; an unreasonable refusal can matter.
more: **Within limits**: $10,000, Keystone's full BI limit
Clear: every term acceptable as written; releases Robert Smith and Keystone only, BI claim only
Reasonable: conditions Keystone can meet, with 30 days to meet them
Documented: the Big Four complete, the gap answered up front
Timed: the clock runs from the adjuster's written acknowledgement of receipt; 07/22/2026 + 30 = 08/21/2026
Terms, extensions and any bad-faith call are Atty. Thorne's; the CM builds, serves and proves delivery

concepts.text: Every bill carries **why the treatment was necessary**: the adjuster evaluates a documented recovery, not a pile of invoices.
more: Lead causation with the 03/13/2026 MRI: a C5-C6 herniation, then the injection
Demand at MMI (06/12/2026), with future care narrated
Specials on John Doe's file: $14,817.40 medical + $1,584.00 wages = **$16,401.40 total**
Specials also cover documented out-of-pocket costs: trip-log mileage to treatment, rides, prescriptions, equipment
The mileage rate follows the governing state's rules, confirmed by Atty. Thorne

concepts.text: Before it goes out, check for **common adjuster traps**: billing overlaps, an unexplained pre-existing condition, unverified balances.
more: Name the 14-Day Gap first: 02/06 → 02/20/2026, no car until 02/18, cost worry, numbness from 02/18
Prove continuity: EMS report, Northgate call-outs (02/09–02/13), urgent-care onset note, Dr. Reyes's Causation Letter
Answer “degenerative” with the MRI: **no significant degenerative change** at the adjacent levels
Never leave the gap out of the timeline and hope Keystone misses it

framework.title: Demand Best Practices

steps.label: 30-Day Rule
steps.text: At MMI the demand targets **MMI plus 30 days**; any later date is Atty. Thorne's

steps.label: Photo Impact
steps.text: Lead the demand with the most graphic photo, Property Damage or injury, to **set the tone**

steps.label: The Why Factor
steps.text: Every bill in the demand carries **why the treatment was necessary** for the client's recovery

framework.note: Treat the carrier like a bank that hasn't paid its bill: the demand presents a debt owed.

d3m1-l2.lead: UM is **the client's financial safety net**: once the at-fault policy is exhausted, first-party coverage makes up the difference, up to its limits.

concepts.text: The gross settlement doesn't matter to the client; **only the net check** does, after fees and unreduced liens.
The at-fault carrier pays its full limit. That **pulls the contract trigger**: the UM claim becomes a second phase.
more: Keystone tendered its $10,000 limit on 08/12/2026
Exhaustion proof: Keystone's Dec Page (03/20/2026) and Smith's affidavit of no other insurance (08/10/2026)
Notice of both UM claims went out in 03/2026; only the demand waits
Exhaustion clauses vary by policy and state: Atty. Thorne confirms the governing rule

concepts.text: The UM carrier consents and waives subrogation, or substitutes its own check: **the UM claim survives** the BI release.
more: The 30-Day Letter went to Harbor Point and Cardinal State on 08/13/2026, the day after the tender
Consents in writing: Harbor Point 08/24, Cardinal State 08/26/2026
**No release to John Doe** for signature before both consents and Atty. Thorne's approval
Keystone's 08/14 draft freed “all other … insurers”; the Limited Release, signed 08/28, names Smith and Keystone only

concepts.text: The at-fault Dec Page, signed release and consents up front **strip the technicality defense** on page one.
The UM carrier insures the client, so the claim shifts **from third-party to first-party**: a contract claim, yet adversarial.
UM doesn't simply pay its limit: it pays **the gap between damages** and what was already collected.
An offset policy subtracts the BI from its UM limit; **add-on or stacked coverage** pays on top.
more: Harbor Point confirmed add-on in writing (03/02/2026): $20,000 of room
Offset would have left only $20,000 – $10,000 = $10,000
Cardinal State's 03/09 letter confirms coverage, not form: get no offset and no anti-stacking cap in writing
Enforceability is a coverage question for Atty. Thorne; the CM records the source

concepts.text: Relative UM answers only **above the primary layers**: the gap it pays starts where BI and Host UM end.
more: Cardinal State: Margaret Doe's policy, John Doe covered as a resident relative (03/09/2026)
Pays above the $30,000 from BI and Host UM, up to $10,000
Its package must show damages above $30,000; the valuation is Atty. Thorne's
Priority between UM policies is Atty. Thorne's call

d3m2-l1.lead: In PI law the demand letter is **your opening move**; adjusters protect the carrier by undervaluing claims, so negotiation is prepared, not improvised.

concepts.text: A demand that reads like a template **gets treated like one**; a tailored presentation earns a real evaluation.
The few facts that would **scare a jury**: they create the carrier's risk, so every call leads with them.
more: Smith ran the stop sign on video, with an independent witness
An objective C5-C6 herniation on the MRI, and an injection
Residual right-arm paresthesia at MMI (06/12/2026)
Anchor on **total Specials, $16,401.40**, not PIP's $5,000

concepts.text: Name your **top two weaknesses** before the adjuster does, and have the documents that answer them in hand.
more: Keystone's top two on this file: the 14-Day Gap and the “degenerative” MRI
Gap: EMS report, 02/09–02/13 call-outs, 02/07 receipt, numbness from 02/18, Causation Letter (06/19/2026)
MRI: Dr. Park, “no significant degenerative change at the adjacent levels”
Present the record, **never your own view** of what it means

concepts.text: Silence after a low number **shifts the burden back**: the adjuster must justify the figure with data.
more: Soft lead: confirm Dana Whitfield has the package and point her to the MRI
Restate the demand and its 08/21/2026 deadline as Atty. Thorne approved them
After a low number, pause, then ask for **her data**
No counter, no move: only Atty. Thorne moves the number or the deadline
Log her exact words; report the offer to Atty. Thorne that day

framework.title: The Negotiation Battle Map

steps.label: Create a Net Sheet
steps.text: Total the liens, costs and attorney's fee: below that, **the client receives $0**

steps.label: Identify the Value Drivers
steps.text: List three facts that would scare a jury; every call leads with them

steps.label: Anticipate the Adjuster's Response
steps.text: Name your **top two weaknesses** and the documents that justify them

steps.label: Prepare the Rebuttal
steps.text: Have the argument ready **before they bring it up**

framework.note: Built before the first call. The CM presents the record; every move on the number is Atty. Thorne's.

d3m2-l2.lead: A UM settlement is won on paper: the package shows the other driver's fault and that **damages exceed what's collected**.

concepts.text: Raw charts and a casual letter carry no risk; a coded summary on a clock **raises the carrier's risk**.
The package sorts proof by job: **coverage, liability, damages**. Diagnostics and a causation narrative answer pre-existing-condition defenses.
Paired ranges that **build a bridge** across a gap, then close in the middle. Atty. Thorne makes every move.
more: Atty. Thorne sets the range and makes every move
The CM relays a bracket only on his **written, word-for-word instruction**
Against a documented gap, he may simply hold
A move with no reciprocal move from the carrier is his to make or refuse

concepts.text: No-fault: mandatory PIP pays first and **suits need a threshold**; at-fault: add-on PIP pays on top
more: No-fault state: PIP is mandatory and pays the client's own medical first, whoever caused the crash
No-fault: suing the at-fault driver needs a serious-injury or monetary threshold; PIP paid is set off
At-fault state: the at-fault driver's BI pays the injury claim; add-on PIP pays on top
At-fault: the right to sue stays open; PIP is a collateral source, not a credit
John Doe's Harbor Point PIP is add-on: exhausted at $5,000.00, non-subrogated, **no lien and no UM cut**
Which rule governs is Atty. Thorne's call; record each carrier's written position

head: Category
What goes in
rows: Police Report, property-damage photos, witness statements, dashcam or surveillance footage
Itemized Medical Bills, complete medical records, lost wage verification, future medical estimates
The demand letter, the client's impact statement, photos of injuries
Signed Limited Release, check copy, at-fault Dec Page, **Consent to Settle**
framework.note: To secure a UM settlement, the package shows the other driver's fault and damages above what's collected.

d3m3-l1.lead: Not all liens are created equal: **legal backing decides negotiability**, from statutory claims that bend least to provider balances that bend most.

concepts.text: Providers treating on an LOP: **high negotiability**, often willing to take a reduction to get paid now.
more: Riverton Spine & Rehab: $6,290.00 billed on the LOP; audit before any ask
Crescent Pain & Spine took Peach State's contract rate: no balance billing of John Doe
No lien is compromised without Atty. Thorne's express authority

concepts.text: A private plan's reimbursement right: moderate, shaped by the **Made Whole and Common Fund** doctrines.
more: Peach State Health Plan asserts $1,860.00; a fully insured plan
Made whole: in many jurisdictions the insurer takes nothing until the client is fully compensated
Common fund: Atty. Thorne asked for the fee share, **one-third off: $1,240.00**
Whether John Doe was made whole is Atty. Thorne's analysis

concepts.text: Government payers bound by **strict federal or state formulas**: low negotiability, and slow to process.
more: Medicare on this file: none, from the Day 2 SSDI/BCRC check
Medicaid: verified separately, no state-agency interest
Record each “none” with its source and date, **the way you record** a lien

concepts.text: Self-funded employer plans governed by federal law: **very low negotiability**, notoriously difficult to reduce.
more: Funding decides the law: obtain the plan documents first
Self-funded: federal law and the plan's own terms; fully insured: generally state insurance law
Peach State is fully insured; the governing-law call is Atty. Thorne's

framework.note: Statutory claims have stronger legal backing than contractual ones. Every compromise needs Atty. Thorne's express authority.

d3m3-l2.lead: Before you ask for a discount, make sure the bill is accurate: an error earns **a demand for correction**, not a favor.

concepts.text: Billing a higher service level than the records support, like **Level 5 for Level 3**: the record decides.
Splitting one service into separately billed parts to **inflate the total**; the records show what was one treatment.
Equal-priority liens split a short fund **in proportion**: each lien's amount over all liens, times what's left.
more: Applies when the fund can't pay every lien and no statute or agreement sets an order
Medicare, a statutory hospital lien or some Medicaid recoveries may take priority; confirm the governing rule
Compute from the fraction, not the rounded percentage: **John Doe nets $0.00**
Track A's fund covers both liens: never tell a provider it would take only a share

concepts.text: The lienholder shouldn't get **a free ride** on the work and costs that created the fund it's repaid from.
more: In many states a lienholder reduces by its proportional share of the fee and costs
The fee share follows the retainer: 33⅓% pre-suit, 40% once suit is filed
Binds some lienholders, only persuades others; an LOP provider is often outside it
Atty. Thorne argues it; the CM shows the math

framework.title: Auditing the Billing to the Payoff

steps.label: Cross-Reference
steps.text: Records against bill: a Level 3 visit billed Level 5 is **corrected, not discounted**

steps.label: Duplicate Charges
steps.text: Look for overlapping dates, especially between hospital stays and individual physician groups

steps.label: Leverage the Common Fund
steps.text: In many states lienholders reduce by their share of fees and costs; Atty. Thorne argues it

steps.label: The Payoff Letter
steps.text: Never pay without a signed letter: **full and final satisfaction** of the lien

framework.note: Corrections first, reductions second: never negotiate a percentage off an inflated bill.

d3m3-l3.lead: The lienholder takes less when it can **see the math** and sign a letter that closes the bill.

concepts.text: The written ask: **audited balance**, recovery, fee and costs, other liens and the common-fund share.
more: Built on audited balances: Riverton Spine & Rehab $6,105.00, Peach State $1,860.00
Atty. Thorne's written authority on file before it goes
**Paper first, phone second**

concepts.text: Atty. Thorne's written floor for each lien: **the CM asks inside it** and routes anything outside.
more: On the call, note the name, the date and every figure
A counter outside it goes back to Atty. Thorne **the same day**
Argue on true facts only: never a smaller fund, never a client refusal
Never accept a figure outside it or promise a provider payment

concepts.text: The lienholder's signed **full-and-final** satisfaction: no balance billing, no collections.
more: Pay from the payoff figure, never a statement
On this file: Peach State $1,240.00, Riverton Spine & Rehab $4,580.00, **$2,145.00 saved**
Update the Lien Tracker and Net Sheet the day it's confirmed; show John Doe his net

d3m4-l1.lead: The Net Sheet is the tool for **transparency and case control**: it shows every dollar's origin and destination before anything leaves trust.

concepts.text: The at-fault driver's carrier; exhausting its limit is usually **a legal prerequisite** to first-party UM.
more: Liens allocated 25%: Peach State $310.00, Riverton Spine & Rehab $1,145.00
Net from this stream: **$5,089.98 to John Doe**

concepts.text: The client's own or **a resident relative's policy**; triggers only once BI is exhausted or the driver is uninsured.
more: Harbor Point $20,000.00 + Cardinal State $10,000.00 = $30,000.00
Fee $10,000.00; costs $365.06, the remainder after the BI share
Liens allocated 75%: Peach State $930.00, Riverton Spine & Rehab $3,435.00
Net from this stream: **$15,269.94 to John Doe**

concepts.text: Carriers audit files closely; tracing every dollar's source keeps liens paid correctly, **without cross-contaminating funds**.
more: Harbor Point's PIP paid $5,000.00 of the bills: a payment source on the Lien Tracker, never recovery
Charge each cost once, as one line or split pro rata (25% / 75% here)
Every cost needs a receipt: five on this file, $486.75
Never mix BI and UM money on one undifferentiated line

concepts.text: Both streams side by side show the client **the compounding power** of the coverages and what negotiation added.
more: BI alone: $6,179.92 against $7,965.00 of unreduced liens, **John Doe nets $0.00**
Possible repeat ESIs ($3,400–$6,800) flagged for Atty. Thorne: the settlement is full and final
Atty. Thorne reviews the Net Sheet and explains it to John Doe before he signs

d3m4-l2.lead: The release is **the contract that ends the dispute**; disbursement then moves money only through verification, documentation, authorization and reconciliation.

concepts.text: The exit document that **ends the right to sue**; its scope decides which claims and carriers survive.
more: Read line by line: who is released, which claims, what John Doe promises
Keystone's 08/14 draft reached “all other … insurers”: it would have cost John Doe $30,000
The BI release leaves the Civic's Property Damage claim open with Keystone PD
Both UM consents (08/24, 08/26) came before the BI release was signed 08/28
Indemnity: John Doe repays the carrier if a lienholder later pursues it, so **every lien is paid**
Every term is Atty. Thorne's; the CM flags and routes, never explains a clause

concepts.text: The truth document: gross to net, and that **full and final** means no return for more money.
more: Shows how $40,000.00 becomes $20,359.92 for John Doe
Contingent-fee rules commonly require one (for example, ABA Model Rule 1.5(c)); confirm the governing rule
Where a cooling-off period applies, no check is cut before it ends
John Doe signed 10/21, after Atty. Thorne explained it

concepts.text: A provider's signed letter that its lien is paid: it **prevents collections against the client** later.
Where suit was filed, the court is told it's over; with prejudice means the case **can't be refiled**.
more: No suit was filed on Track A: no dismissal needed
Where suit is pending: prepare the stipulation for the attorneys' signatures
Docket it and confirm the court's entry; a forgotten dismissal leaves a live case

framework.title: The Disbursement Workflow

steps.label: Verification
steps.text: Review Ready for Payment files; confirm all **conditions precedent** are met

steps.label: Documentation
steps.text: Collect invoices and receipts; ensure each is legible and matches the claim

steps.label: Authorization
steps.text: Sign-off for release: **Atty. Thorne approves and signs**; the packet goes to accounting

steps.label: Reconciliation
steps.text: Confirm receipt of funds; update the case file to reflect Paid status

framework.note: Disbursement serves accuracy, compliance and fraud prevention: no gate opens before the one before it closes.
